recent_articles.title: Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif begins 4-day China visit amid fragile US-Iran truce - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Shehbaz Sharif**, the **Prime Minister of Pakistan**, began a four-day visit to China on Saturday, following visits by **Donald Trump** and **Vladimir Putin**. While **Xi Jinping**, the Chinese president, has not confirmed a meeting with Sharif, Beijing supports Pakistan's role as a mediator.

recent_articles.title: Thousands march in Madrid demanding Spanish PM quit over graft allegations | Protests News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Thousands of people marched in Madrid demanding the resignation of **Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez** over corruption allegations. The protest, organized by civic associations and backed by political parties including the Popular Party (PP) and far-right Vox, was sparked by a series of scandals involving Sanchez's family and entourage.  Sanchez has maintained that the accusations are politically motivated, while his brother is scheduled to stand trial for influence peddling and his wife is under investigation in a separate case.

recent_articles.title: Is United States on verge of a Maduro-like military intervention in Cuba? - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Trump** administration is intensifying pressure on Cuba through sanctions, restrictions on oil shipments, and threats of tariffs. The indictment of former Cuban president Raúl Castro over the 1996 shootdown of Brothers to the Rescue aircraft has been seen as a symbolic move aimed at squeezing the Cuban economy and forcing concessions or regime change.  Analysts believe this approach is similar to the one used against Venezuela but that Cuba presents a more complex challenge due to its consolidated political structure, disciplined security apparatus, and lack of widespread opposition movements. While **Secretary of State Marco Rubio** has advocated for hardline policies against Havana, Cuban officials have expressed openness to negotiations. The US military has increased intelligence-gathering flights near Cuba, while the USS Nimitz entered the Caribbean in May, fueling fears about potential intervention plans. However, experts warn that a full-scale invasion would be risky and costly, potentially destabilizing the region and triggering a humanitarian crisis.

recent_articles.title: Morocco king pardons jailed Senegal football fans for humanitarian reasons | Football News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Morocco’s King Mohammed VI** has pardoned 18 **Senegal** football fans jailed for their involvement in disturbances at the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final. The fans were initially jailed following a pitch invasion after Morocco's penalty win in the final on January 18th.

recent_articles.title: US, Iran move closer to 60-day ceasefire extension: What's in the deal - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The United States and **Iran** are nearing an agreement to extend their ceasefire for another 60 days, with mediators working on a framework for broader negotiations. The proposed deal includes the gradual reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, phased sanctions relief, easing of US restrictions on Iranian ports, and discussions about Iran's uranium stockpile.  The talks aim to prevent renewed military confrontation between Washington and Tehran, but deep disagreements remain over Iran's nuclear program and its right to pursue sovereign interests. The agreement is being closely monitored by regional powers like Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and the United Arab Emirates who fear a renewed conflict could destabilize the Gulf region and worsen the global energy crisis.

recent_articles.title: India's Cockroach Janta Party claims website has been blocked
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Cockroach Janta Party** (CJP), an Indian political parody group, claims its website has been blocked in the country just days after launching. The CJP satirizes the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and claims to represent the unemployed youth in India.

recent_articles.title: Man held for stone pelting near Arani - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Government Railway Police (GRP)** arrested a 34-year-old man, T. Joseph Mani, for damaging the glass windows of the Howrah express train near Arani town in Tiruvannamalai after an argument with other passengers. recent_articles.title: Canada’s new immigration policy could let foreign criminals delay deportation — What we know - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Immigration and Refugee Board (IRB)** has revised its guidelines for postponing deportation hearings, allowing tribunal members to consider ongoing criminal appeals when deciding whether to delay proceedings. The changes, effective June 1st, broaden the criteria for postponements but have drawn criticism from **Conservative** officials who argue they could make it easier for convicted foreign nationals to remain in Canada longer.  The IRB maintains that the updated guidelines aim to improve consistency and fairness in handling postponement requests while emphasizing that authorities can still arrest and detain individuals deemed a public safety risk.

recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Anmol**, an alleged cocaine queenpin arrested in Karachi, operated a sophisticated drug network across Pakistan. recent_articles.title: Turkish and Syrian officials detain 10 individuals with alleged ISIL ties | ISIL/ISIS News | Al Jazeera

recent_articles.title: Twisha Sharma’s husband sent to 7-day police remand; AIIMS Delhi forms panel for second autopsy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samarth Singh**, husband of actor-model Twisha Sharma, was sent to seven days of police custody in Bhopal following his arrest for dowry death and harassment. **AIIMS Delhi** formed a four-member panel to perform a second autopsy on Sharma's body after the Madhya Pradesh High Court ordered it.  The probe team is investigating Mr. Singh's alleged role in Sharma's death, including questioning him and his mother, **Giribala Singh**, who was also named as an accused. The family has demanded a CBI investigation into the case, alleging police misconduct and influence from the accused family.

recent_articles.title: More than 500 children die in measles outbreak in Bangladesh | Health News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Over 500 children have died in Bangladesh from a measles outbreak, the deadliest surge in decades. The **United Nations Children's Agency (UNICEF)** is working on a mass vaccination campaign that has reached 18 million children, but experts warn that gaps in immunizations could worsen antimicrobial resistance.

recent_articles.title: Punjab CTD arrests 13 suspected terrorists in province-wide crackdown - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
